note: Hand-written shift profile -> cost center mappings, for profiles the normal
route cannot reach. A profile is attributed through its scheduled crew, so
one that carries real runs but has no crew on the schedule -- outsourced
work, for instance -- can only be mapped deliberately.
by_name is an exact match, case-insensitive. by_prefix matches the start of
the profile name, longest rule first. Both win over what was learned from
the shift feed, being a decision rather than an observation.
Rename this file to shift_cost_center_overrides.json to put it in effect.
Run diagnose_cost_centers.py to see which profiles still need an entry.
